questions.question: Three of the following four letter - clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Select the odd one out.
questions.solution:
M + 3 → P; P - 2 → N; N + 1 → O

T + 3 → W; W - 2 → U; U + 1 → V

D + 3 → G; G - 2 → E; E + 1 → F

H + 6 → N; N - 2 → L; L - 2 → J

As we can see all options follow a common pattern except for HNLJ.

Hence, HNLJ is the odd among the given options.

questions.question: Three of the following four words are alike in a certain way and one is different. Select the odd word out.
questions.solution:
Perseverance, Firmness and Tenacity are words related to determination.

Tendency means proneness or habit of doing something in a particular way.

Hence, Tendency is the odd word out.

questions.question: Three of the following four numbers are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the number that is different from the rest.
questions.solution:
56 = 7 × 8

12 = 3 × 4

30 = 5 × 6

14 = 2 × 7

Here, 14 is not a product of two consecutive numbers.

Hence, 14 is the odd among the alternatives.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(7, 13, 21)
questions.solution:
Here, in the set given in question the logic followed is:

7 + 6 = 13; 13 + 8 = 21

The same logic is followed in the set (2, 8, 16)

2 + 6 = 8; 8 + 8 = 16

Hence, the set (2, 8, 16) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Arrange the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Medicine

2. Diagnosis

3. Prescription

4. Illness

5. Recovery

6. Doctor
questions.solution:
The correct logical order here will be:

4. Illness → 6. Doctor → 2. Diagnosis → 3. Prescription → 1. Medicine → 5. Recovery

Hence, (4, 6, 2, 3, 1, 5) is the correct order.

questions.question: ‘Action’ is related to ‘Reaction’ in the same way as ‘Stimulus’ is related to ‘_________’.
questions.solution:
An action leads to a reaction.

Similarly, a stimulus leads to a response.

Hence, response is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some cars are vehicles.

No vehicle is a four-wheeler.

**Conclusions:**

I. No car is a four-wheeler.

II. All four-wheelers are cars.

III. Some vehicles are cars.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8695f90d9829a0aa7a0d75676378c742210623dbde9440dde833f921fe5aff46.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. No car is a four-wheeler → False as it is possible but not definite.

II. All four-wheelers are cars → False as it is possible but not definite.

III. Some vehicles are cars → True as some cars are vehicles.

Hence, only conclusion III follows.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

18 + 6 - 6 ÷ 3 × 3 = 6
questions.solution:
i) 18 × 6 - 6 ÷ 3 + 3 = 108 - 2 + 3 = 109 ≠ 6

**ii) 18 ÷ 6 - 6 + 3 × 3 = 3 - 6 + 9 = 6**

iii) 18 - 6 + 6 ÷ 3 × 3 = 18 ≠ 6

iv) 18 + 6 ÷ 6 - 3 × 3 = 10 ≠ 6

Hence, + and ÷ should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct.

questions.question:
Select the number-pair in which two numbers are related in the same way as are two numbers of the following number-pair.

4 : 32
questions.solution:
Here, the logic followed is:

4 : 4 ÷ 2 × (4²) = 4 : 32

Similarly,

6 : 6 ÷ 2 × (6²) = 6 : 108

Hence, 6 : 108 is the correct answer.

questions.question: 10 years ago, a father’s age was 3(1)/(2) times that of his son, and 10 years from now, the father’s age will be 2(1)/(4) times that of the son. What will be the sum of the ages of the father and the son at present?
questions.solution:
Current age of Father = F;

Current age of Son = S

Ten years ago

(F - 10) = 3.5 (S - 10)

F = 3.5S - 35 + 10

3.5S - F = 25 - (i)

Ten years hence

F + 10 = 2.25 (S + 10)

F - 2.25S = 22.5 - 10

F - 2.25S = 12.5 i.e.2F - 4.5S = 25 (ii)

That implies that

3.5 S - F = 2F - 4.5S

8S = 3F

Multiplying (i) by 3

10.5S - 3F = 75 

10.5S - 8S = 75

2.5 S = 75

S = 30;

Hence 3F = 240,

F = 80

Hence, sum of ages of father and son will be 80 + 30 = 110.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(10, 18, 38)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

n : (2n - 2) : 4n - 2

Therefore,

10 : (20 - 2) : (40 - 2)

Similarly,

12 : (24 - 2) : (48 - 2)

Hence, (12, 22, 46) is the correct answer.

questions.question: If BACK is coded as 11312 and CAKE is coded as 51113, then how will MADE be coded as?
questions.solution:
Here, the logic followed is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0cd3609d19b5d0e0963bf3535951e5387599146040cad0724029ecb09e85bce.png] 

B = 2; A = 1; C = 3; K = 11 and further their positional values are written in reverse order.

Similarly,

CAKE= reverse order of (3) (1) (11) (5) = 51113,

MADE = reverse order of (13) (1) (4) (5) = 54113

Hence, 54113 is the correct answer.
